text.tspan: Nguyễn Hoàng Giang, also known as
, currently resides and operates from Ho Chi Minh City. His artistic creations
encompass multimedia, with a particular emphasis on exploring the social and cultural implications of emerging
technologies. Giang's works have gained international recognition, being featured in exhibitions, galleries, and museums
worldwide, including Museo del '900 (Italy), Asian Culture Complex (South Korea), Galerie Nord/Kunstverein Tiergarten
(Germany), ViaFarini (Italy), MartinGoya Business (China), Galerie Quynh (Vietnam), and Nha San Collective
(Vietnam).Since 2020, he has extended his expertise by lecturing on Visual Jockey (VJ) and 3D Graphics at the Digital
Media Design department of RMIT University Vietnam.

tspan.tspan: explores the intersection of media art, design, and
technology in Vietnam. Through exhibitions, artist’s talks and
events, VML connects artists, technologists, and creative
minds both locally and internationally. The lab's mission
focuses on fostering exchange, education, and
experimentation in Vietnam's flourishing media arts scene.

A parallel and parasitic exhibition at Đồng
Xuân Market in Hanoi and Berlin, featuring
artists of Vietnamese origin (both local and
diasporic), exploring themes from the Vina
Manifesto through performance and video. The
project will seek collaboration and approval
from the Hanoi government and Vietnam’s
Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
